synthetic_a.pdf: A lum is a fictional unit of stored light.
Stored light is Q = n * q. Here n is the number of cells and q is light per cell.
Equal-cell theorem: if every cell stores q lums, n cells store n*q lums. Proof: add q exactly n times.
The demonstration device has n = 3 cells.
synthetic_b.pdf: In the demonstration device each cell stores q = 4 lums.
